16542-imperialism-and-the-tracks-of-our-.creator: Unknown
16542-imperialism-and-the-tracks-of-our-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. So our own earliest records tell us that it was on the morning of Saturday, of what is now the nineteenth of December, that the little exploring party from the _Mayflower_, then lying at her anchor in Provincetown Harbor, after a day and night of much trouble and danger, sorely buffeted by wind and wave in rough New England's December seas, found themselves on an island in Plymouth Bay.

31383-the-industrial-canal-and-inner-har.title: The Industrial Canal And Inner Harbor Of New Orleans History
31383-the-industrial-canal-and-inner-har.creator: Thomas Ewing Dabney
31383-the-industrial-canal-and-inner-har.description: A book by Thomas Ewing Dabney. All over the world there is the proof: in the heavens above, and in the waters under the earth. And nowhere has Man won a greater triumph over unspeakable odds than in New Orleans, in the dredging of a canal through buried forests 18,000 years old, the creation of an underground river, and the building of a lock that was thought impossible.

arxiv-2208-06290.title: Solving Linear Systems on a GPU with Hierarchically Off-Diagonal Low-Rank Approximations
arxiv-2208-06290.creator: Chao Chen, Per-Gunnar Martinsson
arxiv-2208-06290.description: Abstract We are interested in solving linear systems arising from three applications: (1) kernel methods in machine learning, (2) discretization of boundary integral equations from mathematical physics, and (3) Schur complements formed in the factorization of many large sparse matrices.

arxiv-2303-06050.title: Optimal foraging strategies can be learned
arxiv-2303-06050.creator: Gorka Muñoz-Gil, Andrea López-Incera, Lukas J. Fiderer, Hans J. Briegel
arxiv-2303-06050.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gorka Muñoz-Gil, Andrea López-Incera, Lukas J. Fiderer, Hans J. Briegel. The foraging behavior of animals is a paradigm of target search in nature. Understanding which foraging strategies are optimal and how animals learn them are central challenges in modeling animal foraging. While the question of optimality has wide-ranging implications across fields such as economy, physics, and ecology, the question of learnability is a topic of ongoing debate in evolutionary biology.

arxiv-2310-20304.title: Advancing Fluid Dynamics Stability Analysis: Construction of Lyapunov Functions via the Generalized Kinetic Energy Approach
arxiv-2310-20304.creator: Péter Tamás Nagy 1
arxiv-2310-20304.description: Abstract The energy method, also known as the Reynolds-Orr equation, is widely utilized in predicting the unconditional stability threshold of shear flows owing to the zero contribution of nonlinear terms to the time derivative of perturbation kinetic energy. However, it often underestimates the critical Reynolds numbers compared to experimental measurements.

arxiv-2406-01299.title: Enhancing Dynamic CT Image Reconstruction with Neural Fields and Optical Flow
arxiv-2406-01299.creator: Pablo Arratia, Matthias J. Ehrhardt, Lisa Kreusser
arxiv-2406-01299.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate image reconstruction for dynamic Computed Tomography. The motion of the target with respect to the measurement acquisition rate leads to highly resolved in time but highly undersampled in space measurements. Such problems pose a major challenge: not accounting for the dynamics of the process leads to a poor reconstruction with non-realistic motion.

arxiv-2411-18385.title: Federated Learning with Uncertainty and Personalization via Efficient Second-order Optimization
arxiv-2411-18385.creator: Shivam Pal, Aishwarya Gupta, Saqib Sarwar, Piyush Rai
arxiv-2411-18385.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shivam Pal, Aishwarya Gupta, Saqib Sarwar, Piyush Rai. Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising method to collaboratively learn from decentralized and heterogeneous data available at different clients without the requirement of data ever leaving the clients. Recent works on FL have advocated taking a Bayesian approach to FL as it offers a principled way to account for the model and predictive uncertainty by learning a posterior distribution for the client and/or server models.

arxiv-2502-02556.title: Titan’s Fluvial & Lacustrine Landscapes
arxiv-2502-02556.creator: Samuel P.D. Birch, Alexander G. Hayes, J. Taylor Perron
arxiv-2502-02556.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Samuel P.D. Birch, Alexander G. Hayes, J. Taylor Perron. I
Introduction

The idea of rivers, lakes and seas on Titan, like on Mars
(
Crossley 2000
)
, was first popularized within the realm of Science Fiction. In ‘The Sirens of Titan’ (1959), Kurt Vonnegut describes Titan as having three seas of similar size to Lake Michigan, connected via valley networks to a series of smaller lakes and ponds. As it turns out, Vonnegut’s description was strikingly similar to reality.

arxiv-2502-09470.title: Convex cocompact groups in real hyperbolic spaces with limit set a Pontryagin sphere
arxiv-2502-09470.creator: Sami Douba, Gye-Seon Lee, Ludovic Marquis, Lorenzo Ruffoni
arxiv-2502-09470.description: Abstract . We exhibit two examples of convex cocompact subgroups of the isometry groups of real hyperbolic spaces with limit set a Pontryagin sphere: one generated by 50 50 reflections of ℍ 4 \mathbb{H}^{4} , and the other by a rotation of order 21 21 and a reflection of ℍ 6 \mathbb{H}^{6} .

arxiv-2502-10515.title: Distributed Application Provisioning over Ethereum based private and permissioned Blockchain: Availability modeling, capacity, and costs planning
arxiv-2502-10515.creator: Carlos Melo, Jamilson Dantas, Paulo Pereira and Paulo Maciel
arxiv-2502-10515.description: Abstract Blockchain and Cloud Computing are two of the main topics related to the distributed computing paradigm, and in the last decade, they have seen exponential growth in their adoption. Cloud computing has long been established as the main mechanism to test, develop, and deliver new applications and services in a distributed manner across the World Wide Web.

arxiv-2512-06960.title: Learning Conditional Independence Differential Graphs From Time-Dependent Data
arxiv-2512-06960.creator: Jitendra K. Tugnait
arxiv-2512-06960.description: Abstract Estimation of differences in conditional independence graphs (CIGs) of two time series Gaussian graphical models (TSGGMs) is investigated where the two TSGGMs are known to have similar structure. The TSGGM structure is encoded in the inverse power spectral density (IPSD) of the time series.

arxiv-2602-22795.title: (1+1)-Dimensional Schrödinger-Poisson equation with contact interaction
arxiv-2602-22795.creator: Óscar Rodríguez-Villalba, Ivan Saychenko, Massimo Pietroni, Sandro Wimberger
arxiv-2602-22795.description: Abstract We investigate the role of contact interactions in the dynamics of fuzzy dark matter (FDM) modeled through the Schrödinger-Poisson equation in one spatial dimension. While the Λ \Lambda CDM paradigm successfully explains structure formation on large scales, its small-scale predictions remain in tension with observations.

pmc-10594146.title: Chemotherapy-Related Toxic Effects and Quality of Life and Physical Functioning in Older Patients
pmc-10594146.creator: Joosje C. Baltussen, Nienke A. de Glas, Yara van Holstein, Marjan van der Elst, Stella Trompet, Anna Uit den Boogaard, Willeke van der Plas-Krijgsman, Geert Labots, Cynthia Holterhues, Jessica M. van der Bol, Lemonitsa H. Mammatas, Gerrit-Jan Liefers, Marije Slingerland, Frederiek van den Bos, Simon
pmc-10594146.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This cohort study assesses the association between grade 3 or higher chemotherapy-related toxic effects and quality of life (QOL) and/or physical functioning or mortality at 6 months and 12 months among patients 70 years or older receiving chemotherapy.

pmc-11496708.title: Multivariate stochastic generation of meteorological data for building simulation through interdependent meteorological processes
pmc-11496708.creator: Zhichao Jiao, Jihui Yuan, Craig Farnham, Kazuo Emura
pmc-11496708.description: In recent years, the uncertainty of weather conditions and the impact of future climate change on building energy assessment has received increasing attention. As an important part of these studies, several types of methods for generating stochastic meteorological data have also been developed.

pmc-12509344.title: Blood pressure at age 40 and key features of cerebral small vessel disease at age 70: data from the ACE 1950 Study
pmc-12509344.creator: Marte M Walle-Hansen, Guri Hagberg, Marius Myrstad, Trygve Berge, Thea Vigen, Hege Ihle-Hansen, Bente Thommessen, Inger Ariansen, Magnus N Lyngbakken, Helge Røsjø, Ole M Rønning, Mona K Beyer, Arnljot Tveit, Håkon Ihle-Hansen
pmc-12509344.description: BackgroundThe separate effects of systolic (SBP) and diastolic blood pressure (DBP) on cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) development needs elucidation. We investigated the association between SBP and DBP at age 40 and two selected brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features of cSVD (lacunes and white matter hyperintensities [WMHs]) at age 70 in a general Norwegian population cohort.

pmc-12802294.title: Sepsis mortality prediction using machine learning and deep learning - a systematic review
pmc-12802294.creator: Mohannad N AbuHaweeleh, Adiba Tabassum Chowdhury, Mehrin Newaz, Purnata Saha, Khandaker Reajul Islam, Jaya Kumar, Muhammad E H Chowdhury, Shona Pedersen
pmc-12802294.description: Sepsis, a critical infection-induced inflammatory condition, poses substantial global health challenges, demanding timely detection for effective intervention. This article explores the application of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) in predicting sepsis using electronic health record (EHR) to enhance patient outcomes. A comprehensive search across PubMed, IEEE Xplore, Google Scholar, and Scopus yielded 39 studies meeting stringent inclusion criteria.

pmc-13248035.title: Outcomes of acute kidney injury in critically ill adults with tropical acute febrile illness: Prospective observational study
pmc-13248035.creator: Sankalp Ranjan, Srishti Jain, Puneet Panwar, Ashish Jain, Ravi Jain
pmc-13248035.description: BACKGROUNDTropical acute febrile illness (TAFI) is a major illness with a large number of intensive care unit (ICU) admissions in tropical regions. It is frequently complicated by acute kidney injury (AKI) and associated poor outcomes. The data on the predictors of outcomes, in terms of in-hospital mortality and renal outcomes, amongst critically-ill TAFI patients from our region remain limited.

pmc-13280268.title: Impact of Biologic Treatment Duration on Drug-Free Remission in Moderate-to-Severe Psoriasis: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13280268.creator: Che-Chia Hsu, Yu-Huei Huang, Tsen-Fang Tsai
pmc-13280268.description: IntroductionPsoriasis is a chronic inflammatory disease that often requires long-term treatment. However, treatment interruption is common. Although several predictors of drug-free remission (DFR) have been reported, the impact of treatment duration remains unclear. In Taiwan, biologics were reimbursed for up to 2.5 years, with re-treatment initiated after relapse.

pmc-13344018.title: Effects of multiple motor point stimulation on knee joint torque compared with conventional functional electrical stimulation
pmc-13344018.creator: Benjamin Kozlowski, Derrick Lim, Meredith Gladish, Arash Arami, Kei Masani
pmc-13344018.description: BackgroundFunctional electrical stimulation (FES) delivers transcutaneous electrical current to motor nerves to artificially evoke muscle contractions and produce joint torque. In neurorehabilitation, FES is commonly applied via a large surface electrode pair placed over a muscle group—an approach that we here refer to as single-electrode stimulation (SES).

uslaw-usc-t46-s4101.title: 46 U.S.C. § 4101 — Application
uslaw-usc-t46-s4101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s4101.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part B (Inspection And Regulation Of Vessels); Chapter 41 (Uninspected Vessels Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. This chapter applies to an uninspected vessel not subject to chapter 45 of this title— (1) on the navigable waters of the United States; or (2) owned in the United States and operating on the high seas.
